associations.rationale: This constructs the sign-twist algebra homomorphism but alone states neither its representation action nor its effect on generated left ideals.
Bijectivity establishes that the sign twist is an automorphism, but it does not state either requested mapping behavior.
The type states only the generated-left-ideal mapping behavior; it does not also state that representations are sent to their sign twists.
This computes the sign automorphism on group-basis elements, a helper identity underlying the representation-level twist.
The type gives only the sign-modified action formula on a module; it does not also state the requested mapping of generated left ideals.
